dogecoin.text: Bitcoin ($BTC) hit $122K and sparked a rally. Support from ETFs, short liquidations, and positive US political signals fuel bullish sentiment. Ether ($ETH) surpassed $3000, XRP, Solana, and Dogecoin grew amid retail interest. Up to $130K–$150K by year-end if macro stays stable.

Dogecoin surpassed the psychological level fueled by whale activity and futures growth. Price up 5.05% to $0.210, with monthly volume peaks of 615.53M and 581.80M coins. Institutional accumulation was clear, and futures reached $1.5B. Bullish trend continues with $0.200 as new
